artifact.note: 3D interactive snow globe webapp with animated snow particles, rotating snow-capped mountain peak, mouse drag rotation, scroll zoom, and glass reflections. Single self-contained HTML file using Canvas 2D with custom 3D vector math and depth-sorted rendering. No external dependencies or network calls.
